DawnSummit_Text_Npc0.en: The sun rises here first. It is\nworth the climb.
DawnSummit_Text_Npc0.fr: Le soleil se lève ici en premier.\nÇa vaut la montée !

DawnSummit_Text_Npc1.fr: Seuls les plus forts atteignent le\nsommet.

DawnSummit_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

DawnSummit_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
